metadata.name: Invoice Chase Agent — Automated Overdue Invoice Recovery
metadata.purpose: Autonomous agent that detects overdue invoices, generates personalized recovery messages, escalates based on days overdue, and tracks recovery metrics. First revenue-generating agent in the Agent Rental Service product line.

identity.system_role: Invoice Chase Agent — Cashflow Recovery Specialist
operating_principles: Never send reminders without consent flags checked
Always maintain professional tone (firm but respectful)
Escalate to human before any legal language
Track every interaction with full audit trail
Measure and report recovery metrics weekly

escalation_triggers: any legal or dispute language detected

deterministic_validators.name: validate_consent_before_messaging
deterministic_validators.rule: BEFORE messaging.send_email OR messaging.send_sms: MUST verify consent_flags[channel] == true

deterministic_validators.name: validate_invoice_still_overdue
deterministic_validators.rule: BEFORE sending reminder: MUST re-check invoice status is still 'unpaid' or 'overdue'

deterministic_validators.name: validate_no_duplicate_reminders
deterministic_validators.rule: MUST check last_reminder_sent_at; SKIP if sent within last 48 hours

deterministic_validators.name: validate_tone_professional
deterministic_validators.rule: Generated message MUST NOT contain: threats, legal language, aggressive tone, caps-lock words

deterministic_validators.name: validate_amount_threshold
deterministic_validators.rule: IF invoice_amount > risk_threshold: MUST create human_task instead of auto-send

gentle_reminder.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice #{{invoice_number}} from {{company_name}}

second_notice.subject: Second Notice: Invoice #{{invoice_number}} - {{days_overdue}} Days Overdue

final_notice.subject: FINAL NOTICE: Invoice #{{invoice_number}} - Action Required

input_validation: Sanitize all email addresses (prevent header injection)
Rate limit per customer (max 1 reminder per 48h per channel)
audit_logging: Log every reminder sent (timestamp, channel, customer, invoice, message_id)
Log every human escalation (trigger reason, context)
idempotency: Store sent messages with tracking_id for 90 days

kill_switch.action: PAUSE all auto-sends + alert admin + require manual review to resume

test_scenarios.name: happy_path_3_day_overdue
test_scenarios.setup: Invoice $500, 3 days overdue, customer has good payment history
test_scenarios.expected: Send gentle_reminder email, log interaction, no escalation
test_scenarios.pass_condition: Message sent AND tone_score >= 0.85 AND no validator failures

test_scenarios.name: no_consent_block
test_scenarios.setup: Invoice $1000, 10 days overdue, customer consent_flags.can_email = false
test_scenarios.expected: BLOCK email send, log violation, create human_task
test_scenarios.pass_condition: No email sent AND violation logged AND human_task created

test_scenarios.name: high_amount_escalation
test_scenarios.pass_condition: No auto-send AND human_task created with priority=high

test_scenarios.name: duplicate_prevention
test_scenarios.setup: Invoice $800, 5 days overdue, reminder sent 24h ago
test_scenarios.expected: Skip reminder (too soon), log skip reason
test_scenarios.pass_condition: No reminder sent AND skip logged with reason='sent_within_48h'

test_scenarios.name: already_paid_race_condition
test_scenarios.setup: Invoice $600, 8 days overdue, but paid 1h ago (status=paid)
test_scenarios.expected: Skip reminder (no longer overdue), log skip
test_scenarios.pass_condition: No reminder sent AND skip logged with reason='status_not_overdue'

acceptance_criteria: < 2% false negatives (missed reminders that should send)
